title: Understanding Correlation
text: Correlation measures the strength and direction of a linear relationship between two variables. A correlation close to $$1$$ or $$-1$$ indicates a strong relationship, while a correlation close to $$0$$ indicates a weak relationship.

title: Correlation with Self Rating
text: Look at the correlation values between each critic's rating and the self rating. Which critic has a stronger correlation with the self rating?

title: Comparing Correlations
text: Critic $$1$$ has a correlation of $$0.10$$ with self rating, while Critic $$2$$ has a correlation of $$-0.75$$ with self rating. Which correlation is stronger in magnitude?

title: Magnitude of Correlation
text: Which correlation is stronger in magnitude: $$0.10$$ or $$-0.75$$?

title: Conclusion
text: Since Critic $$2$$ has a stronger correlation with self rating, it is a more helpful predictor variable than Critic $$1$$.
